label: Virus ROMs
description: Osirus needs a ROM from your own Access Virus A, B or C. Put one or more here; ROM NUMBER on the PLAY page picks which one runs.
hint: A Virus B or C ROM is one 512 KB .bin file. A Virus A ROM is the OS update .mid file (and its presets .mid beside it).

rules.label: Virus OS update (.mid)
rules.note: Looks like a Virus OS update or presets file. The plugin checks it when it loads: a Virus A needs the OS update and the presets file together.
